findings.evidence: 131 mismatches in phq9_total, 39 in phq9_band, 20 in phq9_prorated across respondents with skipped answers.
findings.description: The scoring pipeline mishandles missing data (specifically when item 8 is skipped or when single missing items are encountered) on the PHQ-9, incorrectly dropping or returning null totals for participants who skipped exactly one question, while GAD-7 and RSES scoring is correct.
